name: Twisting Whip (Greater)
text:
The lash of this +2 greater striking extending whip appears impossibly tangled, but it uncoils automatically whenever you use it.

Activate—Winding Labyrinth 1 (concentrate, illusion, mental, visual)

---
Effect If your next action is to make a Strike with the whip or activate its extending rune, a target hit by the whip experiences the sense of being lost in circuitous Darklands caverns. The target must attempt a DC 34 Will save save. If you critically hit, the result of the target's Will save is treated as one degree of success worse.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Winding Labyrinth for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature treats all squares as difficult terrain until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature becomes Slowed 1 for 1 round as it gets its bearings.
